question:
**Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the given word.**

Penalise
solution:
The correct answer is 'Punish'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Penalise is a verb which means to subject to a penalty or punishment.
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• Praise - express warm approval or admiration of.
 
• Punish - inflict a penalty or sanction on (someone) as retribution for an offence, especially a transgression of a legal or moral code.
 
• Pretend - behave so as to make it appear that something is the case when in fact it is not.
 
• Protect - keep safe from harm or injury.
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that punish is the correct synonym for the word penalise.
